svg.title: Player HUD
svg.desc: Player HUD over an Ocean Drive dusk scene with a white sports car driving past Art Deco hotels. 5 of 6 wanted stars from 154 commits in the last 30 days. Health bar: 22 of 30 active days. Energy bar: 972 contributions this year. Focus bar: 2 of 6 public repos touched. Bank = contributions x $10, cash = recent commits x $10. Evidence icons: CCTV = active days, face = repos touched, clothes = public repos, car = yearly contributions, weapon = commits.
